source.title: Tracking data and scripts of analysis to investigate griffon vulture avoidance in Grands Causses, France
source.tag_id_alias: 182208 is shared by two source bird IDs; one final target bird is recorded under a tag used by another source bird outside final 28

justified_claim: Within an independently labeled French *Gyps fulvus* tracking cohort, 5km cell, day-heldout vertical height shape shows an individual-ID-associated repeated distribution under both original GPS and pressure-based altitude columns on the same 27 biological birds and same 364520 source fixes.
limitations: Pressure-based height values may use GPS/barometric calibration sharing source errors; never call two fields independent sensors without device manufacturer metadata.
Day-centered MSL altitude within 5km does NOT subtract fine-scale terrain. The original archive has Elevation_Causses.tif available for terrain-reference test.
Animal ID remains tied to tag ID within each tracking subset; two altitude channels do not unalias biological individual identity and physical instrument.
Source study IDs do not exactly overlap previous Scacco studied Gyps parent by literal bird labels; source parent numeric Movebank ID and tag reuse between studies not confirmed.
This result measures individual identity predictive gain, not wind conditioning, causal thermal flight, competition partitioning, or an all-taxon law.
Original source 30 ID labels included one nonanimal calibration label, absent from the original 28 qualified 5km roster, and excluded in follow-up corrected source ledgers.
Current terrain adjustment using included DEM is necessarily POST-OUTCOME and no new ecological confirmation.
